## Distance-binned score covariance

The correlogram supplements the Moran's I table in Results 04. Positive values
mean that score values in a distance bin are more similar than the full-field
average. It documents spatial continuity and does not identify a geographic
driver.

> 本页补充 Results 04 的 Moran’s I 表。正 covariance 表示该距离段的 score 更相似；该图只描述空间连续性。

```{r}
#| label: fig-supp-pca-correlogram
#| fig-cap: "Distance-binned standardized covariance of equal-area score fields."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4.5
ggplot(correlogram, aes(distance_mid_km / 1000, standardized_covariance, colour = field)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = col_axis, linewidth = wid_axis) +
  geom_line(linewidth = wid_inchart_line) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "PC1" = col_text,
    "PC2" = pal_direction[["warming"]],
    "PC3" = "#756BB1",
    "PC2–PC3 magnitude" = "#1B9E77"
  )) +
  labs(x = "Great-circle separation (10³ km)", y = "Standardized covariance", colour = NULL) +
  theme_base(grid = TRUE) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
